{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion issues
print(sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum(), 'rows had invalid revenue values')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN after conversion
sales_df_clean = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])
print(f'After dropping invalid revenue, {len(sales_df_clean)} rows remain')"}
